period_parameters.setting_rule: Competent owner must agree comparable windows, accrual basis, lag and completeness before any collection; no live trial authorized.

handling.pseudonymization: Custodian assigns stable tokens; re-identification map retained separately under custodian access; pseudonymous records remain restricted.
handling.access: Named authorized custodians and approved analysts only; roles proposed here are not accepted assignments.
handling.retention: UNSET_REQUIRES_CUSTODIAN_POLICY_AND_AUTHORIZATION; minimize retention and record approved deletion/hold rules.
handling.public_derivative: Only disclosure-reviewed non-identifying aggregates and opaque evidence receipts; no raw records, tokens or mapping tables in Git.
handling.unnecessary_fields: Do not request personal names, email, bank details, passport identifiers, precise security routes, medical diagnoses or narrative case contents.

completeness_request: Custodian supplies extraction definition, exclusions, row counts, correction history, source-system totals and missingness receipt in approved storage.
approval_gate: Confirm purpose, lawful/competent authority, handling, fields, comparable periods, extraction burden and guardrail thresholds before request dispatch or collection.
financial_limit: Internal transfers, recoveries and pre-budgeted measures are not automatically incremental savings; no savings finding before financial validation.
purpose: Four GA-directed validation requests; authority must be checked against each applicable adopted provision
proposed_custodian_roles: UNSOS fuel contract and finance custodians
MONUSCO claims control and finance custodians
